key_insight: A passing automated check validates only the checked artefact, not necessarily the original research claim, so fidelity audits and human decisions remain essential.
engineering_relevance: AI-assisted research pipelines should combine validated checking tools, explicit human review gates, and records attributing human and AI contributions.
method: Use validated, agent-usable tools with different grounds of trust to check results.
Audit whether each check addresses the claim as stated, with human decisions at fixed points.
Produce a dialog report attributing work to humans and AI.
evidence_signal: The paper describes mathematics and statistics tool-layer implementations and tests the mathematics implementation on a two-claim example, splitting an ambiguous claim into one refuted reading and one proved reading.
watch_item: Translation fidelity is undecidable in general, so automated proof checking cannot eliminate the need for human interpretation.
paper_title: Trust, but verify, audit and attribute: a human-in-the-loop framework for checking AI-produced research results
